drafts.subject: Remote Research Assistant Inquiry — Safety-Aware Robot Learning
drafts.body:
Dear Dr. Chen,

I am a college student exploring remote research opportunities for the upcoming term. Your recent paper, "Safety-Aware Learning for Dexterous Manipulation," closely matches my interests in embedded perception and reliable control.

I am seeking a strictly remote volunteer role where I can support graduate students with simulation validation, data pipelines, and firmware prototyping (approx. 8–10 hours/week). I would welcome a brief conversation if there is a fit.

Best regards,
Alex Rivera

drafts.subject: Fall Remote RA Inquiry — Vision for Manipulation
drafts.body:
Dear Dr. Blake,

I am writing to express interest in joining your Vision & Action Group as a remote volunteer research assistant. Your work on self-supervised video representations for manipulation is directly relevant to projects I have completed in simulation and computer vision.

I can contribute independently to dataset curation, evaluation scripts, and reproducible experiments. Happy to share a CV and discuss a short intro call.

Sincerely,
Alex Rivera

drafts.subject: Research Inquiry — Language-Conditioned Robot Policies
drafts.body:
Dear Dr. Nair,

I am a student interested in embodied AI and would love to support your lab's work on language-conditioned policies for household robots. I have experience building Python tooling for experiment tracking and simulation-based failure testing.

I am available for a remote volunteer commitment this term and would appreciate the chance to learn how I can help.

Thank you for your time,
Alex Rivera
